scope: Field manual, grouped Settings and contextual Pause

rubric.note: Manual separates premise, practical actions and a persistent takeaway.
The five pages and settings fit at 1.15 scale without label collisions.
Site, wave, combat time, health and currencies appear beside the actions.
Previous disables on page one; final action distinguishes title from paused run.
Grouped preferences include explanatory copy and a visible volume value.
Escape and controller Back cancel rebinding; closing clears pending capture.
Brass, green enamel and retained title backdrop match existing menus.
Existing Saint remains graphic beside painted machines; no replacement is claimed.
Cream and gold headings separate from muted supporting text on opaque panels.
Native normal/large captures at two viewports and identical paused-state hashes; no human test claimed.

limitation: Rendered fixtures and synthetic input tests do not establish human comprehension or physical controller usability. The retained Saint is a procedural sprite; illustration fidelity remains mixed by design.
next_task: Give the Memory Crane and Foreman Engine painted bodies and state-driven mechanical animation.
